tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches active job listings on JobCrawls, an aggregator of jobs in Finland. The index covers jobs located in Finland plus remote roles open to Finland, and has no listings for other countries. Example queries: "find nurse jobs in Tampere", "onko Helsingissä avoimia etätyöpaikkoja ohjelmistokehittäj

tools.name: list_job_filters
tools.description: Returns the facet attributes jobs can be filtered by (for example field, location, job type, seniority level, skills and languages), with the values currently present in active listings and how many listings have each value. The values are the exact strings search_jobs accepts in its `filters` param

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Returns the complete details of one JobCrawls listing by its id (the `id` field of a search_jobs result): full description, requirements, responsibilities, benefits, salary, company, location, application deadline and a direct link to the posting.
